host: node packages/wasix-openssh/cert/run.mjs --tarball <package.tgz>: boots slicc-kernel Node entry with uplink to (1) an ephemeral host OpenSSH sshd (temp keys, loopback), (2) cert/none-auth-server.py, (3) a seeded bare git repo on the host. Runs cert/*.mjs checklist.

patches.0001-wasix-stub-getrrsetbyname.patch: SSHFP/DNSSEC getrrsetbyname always ERRSET_FAIL (no resolv.h); ordinary DNS via kernel — exercised by ssh to sshd.cert.internal / none.cert.internal
patches.0002-wasix-scp-sftp-posix-spawn.patch: scp/sftp posix_spawnp with per-call argv copy (no global args pollution; multi-source / -3)
patches.0003-wasix-quiet-unsupported-ip-tos.patc: set_sock_tos ignores ENOSYS/EOPNOTSUPP/ENOPROTOOPT so stderr stays clean
patches.0004-wasix-ssh-keygen-known-hosts-backup: ssh-keygen -R/-H backup falls back to copy when link() fails

checklist: ssh -V / ssh-keygen -t ed25519: versions and key file modes 0600 under slicc_fs
identity: $HOME used for ~/.ssh; default user from getpwuid (slicc_identity) or documented $USER / user@host fallback until H1
exec: ssh via uplink to host sshd — echo; exit 3 → 3; stdin pipe to remote cat
stderr: ssh host 'echo x >&2' → stderr exactly "x\n" (no IP_TOS spam)
known_hosts: StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new then mismatch refusal (isolated known_hosts file)
ssh-keygen -R hostname: updates known_hosts and keeps .old without hard links
PTY ssh -t via openTerminal: stty size matches cols/rows; type a command; exit; local ^C interrupts local ssh (slicc-kernel#247)
scp + sftp -b: 256 KiB up/down with sha256 checksums
scp two remote sources (sftp mode and -O) into a local dir; scp -3 remote→remote
GIT_SSH_COMMAND=ssh + wasm-git 2.55.0-13: clone and push to host bare repo over sshd
ssh-add -l without agent → exit 2 (ssh-agent not shipped; see README)
